Tap a road, a culvert dot or a lot.
How to use: tap a road for its surface, steepness and links to log a job; tap a dot for the culvert record; zoom in and tap a lot to see its address and road. For an owner's call, search the street address from the work order. "Satellite view" opens Google Maps at that spot.
Road lines come from the U.S. Census and can be off by a few meters. Surface is read from lidar brightness (dark = asphalt). Paving done after 2019 will still show as gravel.
